frameworks.summary: PyTorch Kokoro via KPipeline (hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) on CPU. Weighted blends are pre-mixed tensors, not torch.mean. Weights are not bundled; download only if GEN_AUDIO_ALLOW_HF_DOWNLOAD=1.

kokoro-onnx speaks Misaki phonemes via create(..., is_phonemes=true), in chunks of at most 510 phonemes. A blend voice is the ndarray from blend_from_pack. A single voice passes its pack id. Files come from GEN_AUDIO_KOKORO_MODEL and GEN_AUDIO_KOKORO_VOICES.
Misaki G2P for Kokoro. transformer is false on Python 3.14. custom_entries are merged into lexicon.golds. Phonemes are passed to Kokoro with is_phonemes. This row does not emit a waveform.

VibeVoice long-form TTS. 1.5B runs on CPU when local weights exist and is called with voice_samples, DDPM steps, cfg_scale, and the tokenizer. 7B is GPU-only. A reference WAV is not pinned to one checkpoint.
VibeVoice-Realtime presets. Not runnable until weights exist and model_revision is pinned. Load with torch.load weights_only=true. experimental is every file prefix except built-in en and in.
Gated nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1 under the NVIDIA Open Model License. Speech-to-speech, not a text-to-speech cast slot. Refuses until HF access and weights exist. The offline tool needs an input wav.
